business_problem: Legal teams face high document volumes and limited time, constraining contract review, due diligence, and other work that requires detailed analysis and lawyer judgment.
solution_summary: Legora uses OpenAI models through its API as a key provider for its legal AI platform, supporting agentic legal workflows and large-scale contract review. Its Tabular Review workflow applies analysis across thousands of contracts and multiple questions, surfacing risks for lawyer review; the source does not specify how contracts are ingested, indexed, stored, or how models are hosted. Legora also exposes its capabilities through a plugin for ChatGPT. Internally, teams use Codex coding agents to prototype engineering approaches and investigate logs, while ChatGPT Work supports staff workflows; these tools are distinct from the legal product's model integration. Reported results include reduced NDA review effort inside Legora and faster contract turnaround and diligence for a Fortune 100 customer.
